notes.title: Full stop possible!
notes.content:
When you press the key below because the difficulty of the game is judged to be difficult, the movement speed was originally reduced, but now you can experience a complete stop. And if you want to move again, you can use jump to move again.

However, as everyone knows, be careful that you cannot change direction when you jump!

notes.title: Add key setting and escape UI
notes.content: When you press the ESC key, you can set the key and created an escape UI that returns to the first place when you are put on the map.

notes.title: Error Fix
notes.content: Fixed an error that could not come out when stuck on the wall
